operative_spans.label: Complete operative paragraph
operative_spans.text:
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and the
laws of the United States and in order to extend the President’s Council
on Sustainable Development, it is hereby ordered that section 4(b) of Execu-
tive Order No. 12852, as amended, is further amended by deleting ‘‘for
a period of 2 years from the date of this order, unless the Council’s charter
is subsequently extended’’ and inserting in lieu thereof ‘‘until June 29,
1997, unless otherwise extended.’’

complete_section_checklist: No numbered sections within EO:13053; the complete instrument consists of the authority/purpose recital and one operative paragraph with three semicolon-separated amendment actions, followed by signature/execution and publication metadata.
Action 1 changes EO 12852 section 1 from 29 to 35.
Action 2 changes the text in EO 12852 sections 3(d) and 4(a) from ‘Department of the Interior’ to ‘Department of Energy’.
Action 3 changes the date text in EO 12852 section 4(b) from June 29, 1997 to February 28, 1999.
The full operative paragraph is held-text characters [729,1366).

operative_spans.label: Complete operative paragraph
operative_spans.text:
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and the
laws of the United States of America, and in order to amend Executive
Order 12852 for various purposes, it is hereby ordered that Executive Order
12852, as amended, is further amended by deleting the number ‘‘29’’ from
section 1 and inserting the number ‘‘35’’ in lieu thereof; by deleting from
section 3(d) and 4(a) the text ‘‘Department of the Interior’’ and inserting
in lieu thereof the following text: ‘‘Department of Energy’’; and by deleting
from section 4(b) the text ‘‘June 29, 1997’’ and inserting in lieu thereof
the following text: ‘‘February 28, 1999.’’
